elements.explorer-header: .explorer-header — workspace name displayed in uppercase, accent color
elements.tree-item: .tree-item — individual file or directory row with arrow icon and name
elements.tree-item-arrow: .tree-item-arrow — directory arrow (▸ collapsed / ▾ expanded in amber) or file bullet (· in per-extension color)
elements.child-container: .child-container — nested children container below directory items
elements.inline-input: .inline-input — input element for file/folder creation and rename

interactions.name: expand_dir
interactions.action: If expanded → collapse (remove children from expanded set, hide childContainer, icon ▸). If collapsed → add to expanded set, loadDir for children, show childContainer, icon ▾.

interactions.name: open_file
interactions.action: Fire onFileOpen callback, then selectFile to highlight the file with .is-file-selected class.

interactions.name: context_menu_file
interactions.action: Show ContextMenu with items: Copy, Paste, Rename, Delete, plus .md-specific 'Open to {Markdown label}' items from markdownOpeners.

examples.Copy: Store file path in clipboard buffer
examples.Rename: Show inline input with current name → Enter: fs:rename → refresh
examples.Delete: Open ConfirmModal → if confirmed, fs:delete → refresh
examples.Open to Markdown: Fire markdownOpeners callback with filePath and label

interactions.name: context_menu_dir
interactions.action: Show ContextMenu with items: New File, New Folder, Copy, Paste, Rename, Delete.

examples.New File: Show inline input in directory → Enter: fs:writeFile → refresh
examples.New Folder: Show inline input in directory → Enter: fs:mkdir → refresh

interactions.name: context_menu_empty
interactions.action: Show ContextMenu with items: New File, New Folder, Paste.

interactions.name: create_file_or_folder
interactions.trigger: click 'New File' or 'New Folder' from context menu
interactions.action: Show inline input row in target directory → Enter commits via fs:writeFile / fs:mkdir → refresh tree. Escape cancels and removes input. Blur also commits.

interactions.name: rename_item
interactions.trigger: click 'Rename' from context menu on file or directory
interactions.action: Replace name span with inline input pre-filled with original name → Enter commits via fs:rename → refresh tree. Escape cancels and restores original name.

interactions.name: delete_item
interactions.action: Open ConfirmModal with delete message → if confirmed, IPC fs:delete → refresh tree.

interactions.name: paste_item
interactions.action: Resolve name conflicts by appending _copy_N suffix → IPC fs:copy from clipboard path to target directory → refresh tree.

interactions.name: file_changed
interactions.action: Reload directory tree preserving current expanded set.

states.empty: Tree displays 'No workspace' message when no rootPath is set.
states.error: Tree displays 'Unable to read directory' error message.
states.normal: Tree rendered with directory items (sorted first) and file items (sorted alphabetically within).
states.file-selected: A file item has .is-file-selected class applied for visual highlight.

rendering.file-colors: TS/JS files: var(--accent). CSS files: var(--accent2). JSON/YAML files: var(--amber). MD files: var(--green). Other files: var(--primary).
